description: This file contains functions for configuring search settings and setting up Elasticsearch hooks in SuiteCRM, including installing logic hooks and configuring search parameters.

methods.name: install_search
methods.description: Sets default search controller, engine, and pagination settings in the global configuration.

methods.name: install_es
methods.description: Configures Elasticsearch settings and installs related logic hooks.

methods.name: installESHooks
methods.description: Sets up Elasticsearch-related logic hooks for after_save and after_delete events.
